title: EU expands planned AI gigafactory program
verifiedFacts: Reporting on 2026-07-30 described an EU plan for seven AI gigafactories with public and targeted private investment.
inference: Compute infrastructure is increasingly being organized as public-private industrial policy rather than isolated cloud procurement.
significance: Potential demand for provenance, orchestration, supplier mapping, and accountable cross-provider infrastructure layers.
assumptions: The announced plan proceeds substantially as described.
knownLimitations: Primary EU program documents were not captured in this reconstruction.
